tagline: A calm always-on display for classrooms and desks
about: Schun AOD turns a spare screen into a calm classroom display. A large clock and the date sit in the middle, with today's timetable and this week's cafeteria menu from NEIS beside it, weather for your school or a place you choose, and a quiet daily quote. Everything runs on one dimmed, low-brightness screen with pixel shift and a brightness control so OLED panels are not burned in by the clock. Pick your school and class inside OPUS once and the timetable and meals arrive on their own; the clock, date, timetable, meals, weather, quote, calendar and hint line can each be turned off when you do not need them.
